penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Each customer deployment requires bespoke technical architecture work — configuring local VM sync, network setup, data replication — that cannot be automated by Claude prompts alone.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise/mid-market SaaS vendor sales and scoping require discovery calls, security reviews, and stakeholder alignment before any deployment can begin.

penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: End buyers are in regulated sectors (finance, healthcare, government) — compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC 2, data residency laws) create legal/liability exposure and add significant delivery complexity.

rationale: The pain is real and buyers genuinely pay (enterprise compliance deals are large-ticket), but this is fundamentally a technical consulting and professional services engagement — not a product a solo non-technical operator can build and run hands-off. Every customer deployment requires custom infrastructure work, enterprise sales cycles, and ongoing compliance support. Operational autonomy (2) and buildability_with_ai (3) are both critically low, and three penalties apply simultaneously. This is the wrong shape for this factory.
solution_plan: Not recommended for build by a solo non-technical operator. The problem requires deep DevOps/infrastructure expertise (Azure VMs, data replication, network config), enterprise sales motions, and ongoing compliance management — none of which Claude can automate end-to-end. A solo operator without a technical co-founder or prior enterprise infrastructure experience cannot credibly deliver this. If the operator has a technical partner, this could be a consulting engagement, not a productized micro-service.
notes: operational_autonomy (2) and buildability_with_ai (3) critically below build_gate floors. Total 1.0 after penalties is well below min_total_to_validate. Three compounding penalties (requires_human_fulfillment, requires_synchronous_human, regulated_industry) reflect the genuine delivery reality.
